const { visualid } = createParams('visualid')

setcpm(124/4)

// ---- INTRO: flotando ----
const intro = stack(
  s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(perlin.range(.1,.3)).visualid("drum_hh"),
  note("<[d4,f4,a4,c5] [bb3,d4,f4,a4]>")
    .s("triangle").attack(.3).release(1).gain(.25).room(.6)
    .visualid("harmony"),
  note("~ a5 ~ [f5 e5]").s("sine").gain(.25).delay(.4).room(.5)
    .visualid("melody")
)

// ---- GROOVE: entra el cuerpo ----
const groove = stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.95).visualid("drum_bd"),
  s("~ cp ~ [cp cp]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.6).visualid("drum_cp"),
  s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.4).visualid("drum_hh"),
  s("~ ~ ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.35).visualid("drum_oh"),
  note("d2 ~ d3 ~ f2 ~ [g2 a2] ~")
    .s("square").lpf(sine.range(300,900).slow(4)).gain(.55).release(.1),
  note("<[d4,f4,a4,c5] [bb3,d4,f4,a4] [c4,e4,g4,bb4] [a3,c#4,e4,g4]>")
    .struct("~ x ~ x").s("sawtooth").lpf(1200).gain(.22).room(.3)
    .visualid("harmony"),
  n("<0 2 4 [5 4]>*4").scale("D4:minor").s("triangle").gain(.3).delay(.25)
    .sometimesBy(.4, x=>x.ply(2))
    .visualid("melody")
)

// ---- DROP: todo al frente ----
const drop = stack(
  s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1).visualid("drum_bd"),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.85).room(.2).visualid("drum_cp"),
  s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.3).visualid("drum_hh"),
  s("[~ oh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.4).visualid("drum_oh"),
  note("<d2 bb1 c2 a1>*8")
    .s("sawtooth").lpf(700).gain(.65).release(.08),
  note("<[d4,f4,a4,c5] [bb3,d4,f4,a4] [c4,e4,g4,bb4] [a3,c#4,e4,g4]>")
    .struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").s("sawtooth").lpf(2000).gain(.25).release(.1)
    .visualid("harmony"),
  n("0 4 7 9 7 4 [9 11] 7").scale("D5:minor").s("triangle").gain(.4)
    .room(.4).delay(.2)
    .visualid("melody")
)

// ---- QUIEBRE: se cae el piso ----
const quiebre = stack(
  s("~ ~ ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").room(.7).gain(.7).visualid("drum_cp"),
  note("<[d4,f4,a4,c5] [a3,c#4,e4,g4]>")
    .s("triangle").attack(.5).release(2).gain(.3).room(.7)
    .visualid("harmony"),
  n("<7 [9 7] 4 ~>").scale("D5:minor").s("sine").gain(.3).delay(.5)
    .visualid("melody")
)

// ---- ESTRUCTURA ----
const song = arrange(
  [4, intro],
  [8, groove],
  [8, drop],
  [4, quiebre],
  [8, drop]
)

// Salida doble: audio normal + eventos OSC para TouchDesigner
$: stack(song, song.osc())
